question: Put in chronological order the Major League Baseball seasons in which Barry Bonds, Tony Gwynn, and Benny Kauff hit for a .370 batting average.
output_text:

• Tony Gwynn hit .370 (.37012) in 1987 with the San Diego Padres [1]

• Benny Kauff hit .370 (.36953) in 1914 with the Indianapolis Hoosiers [1]

Final answer: In chronological order, the MLB seasons in which these three players hit .370 are:
1. 1914 - Benny Kauff
2. 1987 - Tony Gwynn
3. 2002 - Barry Bonds
